title: Operator reconciliation of a stranded execution
summary: An execution whose owner ended or stopped heartbeating, or whose recovery receipt is invalid, has no owner left to abort, adopt or walk-end it. yoke qa plan reconcile --project P --execution-id ID --reason TEXT settles it. A session needs a live steering seat covering the project (others get steering_seat_required); a session-less call needs the control-plane organization administrator and cannot take over a review. It never settles an active, runner-driven walk (qa_reconcile_runner_driven names yoke qa plan abort), a parked owner's walk (qa_reconcile_owner_parked) or a heartbeating one (qa_reconcile_execution_live). A held host lease without recorded recovery records cancellation, marked as reconcile's so the retry skips the staleness check a reset's lease heartbeat would fail, and refuses qa_reconcile_host_recovery_required with the exact yoke test-machine reset command, or coordination-claim operator-release without a declared baseline. A mission's own review lease and released leases need no proof. A pending review whose capture is judgeable (artifacts, not degraded) passes to the caller (review_handoff) and next_command names review-begin; otherwise the review closes with no verdict and the execution settles aborted under qa-plan-operator-reconciled. Every run writes a qa_plan_execution_reconciliations receipt with caller, reason, prior state and owner, and released leases. qa_recovery_receipt_invalid, qa_abort_walk_end_required for an ended owner, and unprovable adoption name the command with its arguments. Source tests are not deployed proof.
